analyst_view.overall: Slavia are 34th of 36 with 1 point and Villarreal 28th with 3, so both are below the top-24 line and need a win. Slavia are top of the Czech league after a 2-0 win at Olomouc on Saturday, but David Moses went off injured there and Jindřich Trpišovský expects a longer absence, which the numbers do not know. Villarreal lost 3-2 at Barcelona on Sunday after leading 2-0 and finished with ten men (Pau Navarro's red card is a league matter); Íñigo Pérez said none of his injured players is back yet, so Gerard Moreno, Juan Foyth and Ilias Akhomach still look out alongside the counted Alassane Diatta. Absences on both sides roughly cancel out, nothing changed since yesterday's view, and no referee is named yet, so the view stays with the numbers. I found no dedicated preview of this match yet (news was thin), so the view rests on each club's own team news from the weekend.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.7 goals (1.2 Slavia, 2.4 Villarreal), already counting both sides' recent scoring and Diatta's absence. Villarreal are still without Gerard Moreno and Akhomach up front, while Slavia lose Moses; Villarreal still scored twice at Barcelona, and both teams need a win, so these pull both ways and I stay at 3.7.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, already raised for Slavia's recent corner count (+5.8%). Slavia attack down the wings with wing-backs and Villarreal like wide play too; losing Moses is a small hit for Slavia's flank play but not enough to move, so I stay at 9.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.7 cards, already taking off Slavia's unusually low recent card count (-9.8%) and adding Villarreal's high one (+5.2%). Two teams that both need the result can make for a tense game, but there is no bad blood and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 4.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.3 shots, already lifted for both sides' heavy recent shooting (+16% Slavia, +8.1% Villarreal). Slavia's high-tempo home game fits that picture; Villarreal's missing attackers could cut a little, but they did not stop them scoring twice at Barcelona, so I stay at 31.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target, already counting Slavia's sharper recent finishing (+11.3%). With absences on both sides and no lineups yet, I see nothing they miss and stay at 10.1.
